d:
Chhath mahaparv ke mauke par jan suraj ke sansthapak prashant kishor patna ke chhath ghat pahunche. is dauran unhonne biharvasiyon ko chhath ki shubhkamnaen din aur ghaton ki saphaee ko lekar prashasan ke kam par santosh jataya. vahin maharashtr men chhath puja ko lekar raj thakre ki tippani par prashant kishor ne tikhi pratikriya di.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
